@Ads Team
﻿
Time to optimize maadi law campaign, here are my suggestions, open to yours:﻿﻿﻿

1. Cut

  • Pause Calls LaGrange Road and Calls Ad 6.
  • Standing rule from now on: once an ad has spent $60, pause it if its cost is more than 2x its ad set's average.

2. Split English and Arabic

  • Move the English instant forms ad set into its own campaign with its own budget.
  • Rebuild it around the #3 creative, since that's the proven winner.

3. Launch retargeting

  • Audiences: 50%+ video viewers, site visitors, form openers, and IG/FB engagers from the last 90 days. Exclude anyone who already submitted a lead.
  • Creative: Ads 2, 4, 5 and 9, each with its dashcam hook. Hold Ad 7 until Sharif confirms whether the figure is $35M or $25M.

4. Clean up placements

  • Remove Audience Network from both forms ad sets, since it tends to produce junk form fills.

creator: Ads Team
body:
@Sohib Boundaoui ﻿
﻿
﻿Salam, 
﻿

I have been reviewing the Google Ads performance. The campaigns are currently being optimized for the GHL goal “Collect document.” However, since this goal is further down the funnel, there are currently no conversion signals coming back from GHL, so the campaigns do not have enough signals to optimize towards.
﻿

I would highly recommend that we also add the website leads event as a conversion goal for the campaigns, so they can start receiving some signals to optimize towards.


﻿This is because when the campaign start seeing some conversion it give the ad more credibility and it also improves the ad rank.

creator: Ads Team
body:
@Sohib Boundaoui ﻿
﻿
﻿﻿﻿

Following changes were made in  Google Ads account as part of ongoing campaign optimization.
﻿
I paused around 30 keywords that were very broad, like “free telemedicine” and “affordable healthcare”. They did not bring any calls or leads, so I stopped them to save budget.
﻿

I also added new keywords for people who are looking for a primary care doctor, family doctor, health clinic or obgyn near them. Along with this,
﻿I added 3 negative keywords, so your ads will not show when people search “types of specialist clinics”, “hospital department near me” or “type of health insurance cover”. These people are only looking for information, not for a clinic to visit.
